description: This file implements Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) communication for a pong game on a microcontroller, including connection management, service discovery, notification handling, and data transmission of ball position and lost signals.

methods.name: ble_send_ball
methods.description: Sends ball position and velocity data via GATT notification.

methods.name: ble_send_lost
methods.description: Sends a 'lost' signal via GATT notification.

methods.name: ble_init
methods.description: Initializes the BLE subsystem and sets up the primary service.

methods.name: ble_connect
methods.description: Starts BLE scanning and connection process.

methods.name: ble_cancel_connect
methods.description: Cancels ongoing BLE connection or advertising attempts.
